geometry_source: Ember Atlas project-defined study extents, version 1. Rectangles are analytical selections, not official biome or administrative boundaries.

regions.name: Pantanal
regions.extent_note: 59–54°W, 23–15°S; preserves the evaluated Pantanal study area.

regions.name: Southern Amazon
regions.extent_note: Southern Amazon study area: 65–48°W, 13–5°S; a rectangular southern-arc selection.

regions.name: Cerrado
regions.extent_note: Cerrado study area: 55–44°W, 20–8°S; not the official biome mask.

regions.name: Gran Chaco
regions.extent_note: Gran Chaco study area: 66–57°W, 32–17°S; includes parts of Argentina, Bolivia and Paraguay.

regions.name: California
regions.extent_note: California study area: 125–114°W, 32–42.5°N; a box including adjacent land and ocean, not a state mask.

regions.name: Southeastern Australia
regions.extent_note: 140–154°E, 44–28°S; southeast mainland and Tasmania, including adjacent land/ocean.

regions.name: Iberian Peninsula
regions.extent_note: Iberian study area: 10°W–4°E, 35–44.5°N; includes adjacent land and ocean.

regions.name: Siberia
regions.extent_note: Siberia study area: 60–140°E, 50–72°N; a broad central/eastern Russian selection, not all Siberia or Russia.
